title: In-Context Scheming Without Goal-Nudging: Replicate the Rare-Spontaneous Result

original_idea.body: # In-Context Scheming Without Goal-Nudging. Re-run a simplified scheming scenario in strongly-nudged vs goal-only conditions on 2-3 open models; quantify spontaneous scheming rate and nudge effect size.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused two-condition rate comparison; scenario simplification adds modest effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Foundational scheming baseline labs underweight; open models, third-party scrutiny.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only agentic scenarios on open models.

novelty.reasoning: Apollo scheming results recent; open-model goal-only replication plausibly open.
